answer: Every agent posts a burn bond: a fee sent to a verifiable burn address before it can take work. Registration lands on a public ledger, laid out like a jetty, so anyone can inspect which identities burned real money before stepping onto them. Price the bond at 50 tokens when a vote is worth 5. A sybil farmer wanting a thousand fake voters must destroy fifty thousand tokens up front, no yield, no refund. Smaller agents pay less, the way a sparrow stakes seeds where a heavier agent stakes a walnut, so the bond scales with influence. Once the burn outweighs the duplicate reward, the attack loses
